notes: Sources: 2018_00_link (Staff Handbook 2016); 2018_01 HR paid leave page; 2018_02 chapter 9; 2018_03 chapter 7; 2018_04 FMLA policy; 2018_05 tenure-clock policy (transcription); 2018_06 modified-duties policy (transcription).
Governing faculty documents are saved (Faculty Handbook ch. 7 and 9; Policies 02.01.62 and 02.01.63; FMLA Policy 06.02.04), so missing is false (the no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply).

Dates: reference date 2018-03-13. Policies 02.01.62 and 02.01.63 are dated February 2017 and approved 2017-03-06, in force on the reference date. Chapters 7 and 9 are 2016 captures (latest before the reference date; the version notes identical live text). The Staff Handbook is the 2016 edition (rev. 12/15/16). The HR page capture (2017-09-23) is undated.

Faculty Handbook 7.3.2.4 (one-year extension on request, 2016 capture) conflicts with Policy 02.01.63 (Feb 2017: automatic one-year extension for birth or adoption, up to two extensions, maximum nine years); the later policy is read as governing for a birth (c11), and c14 is flagged conflicting_sources.

Faculty with academic-year (nine-month) appointments, the standard tenure-stream appointment, earn no sick or vacation leave (9.13, 9.16); their paid time for a birth comes only from the discretionary 9.13 sick-leave grants (c3-c6, generic) and the modified-duties semester (c1).

Staff Handbook 'Maternity Leave': 'The University does not have a separate “maternity leave” policy'; staff use sick leave, then vacation, then unpaid FMLA and medical leave (c17 -> c18 -> c19, FMLA concurrent). The HR page restates this for staff and 12-month faculty; it adds no provision (summary). These staff provisions are coded with the staff group, not as faculty provisions.

Faculty Handbook 9.11 Unpaid Leave of Absence (further study and activities that enhance professional capacities) cannot be used for a birth and is not a component; sabbatical, military, bereavement, jury duty, interrupted operations and severe weather leave likewise.

Faculty Handbook 9.14 refers compensation to 'customary institutional practices' and to the terms for 'leaves granted for temporary disability or personal emergencies'; no separate temporary-disability policy is saved beyond 9.13 (cross-reference not saved: customary institutional practices). The faculty-handbook appendices (E, F, I) and the FMLA policy's linked guides and forms are cited but not saved.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks running alongside the 9.14 childbearing leave (negotiated, no length) and, at discretion, the 9.13 sick leave with pay (rest of the semester, or up to six months; alternatives) -> modified-duties semester also available (no order stated; typically the birth semester or the next).
Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks alongside the 9.14 family-emergency leave (negotiated, no length) -> modified-duties semester also available for the primary caregiver (no order stated).
Calendar: 'The academic year encompasses the fall and spring semesters' states the kind of term only; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.
